description.main: Spring/Summer 2026 issue of Apartamento, with Eileen Myles, Rosalind Nashashibi, Enzo Cucchi, Suzanne Jackson, Jerry Torre of Grey Gardens, the Orta family at Les Moulins, and a story by Jina Khayyer.
description.extended:
Spring/Summer 2026, with Eileen Myles, Rosalind Nashashibi, Enzo Cucchi, Suzanne Jackson, Jerry Torre of Grey Gardens, the Orta family at Les Moulins, and a story by Jina Khayyer.

The issue features the poet Eileen Myles, Rosalind Nashashibi, Kwangho Lee, Mariana Chkonia, Enzo Cucchi, Suzanne Jackson, Kazunori Hamana, Priyanka Sharma and Dushyant Bansal, Paolo Deganello, the architects Sofía von Ellrichshausen and Mauricio Pezo, the filmmaker Rodrigo Sorogoyen, and Jean-Paul Beaujard. One piece is on Jerry Torre, "the Marble Faun of Grey Gardens", and another, on Lucy, Jorge, and Leo Orta, is titled "The Legacy of Les Moulins". Khayyer's story "In the Heart of the Cat" is translated by Joel Scott. Dimitri Broquard of FLAG draws the comic "How to build Max Lamb's DIY Baby Chair", and the issue carries an homage to the life and work of George Tourkovasilis.

Jina Khayyer is usually the interviewer in Apartamento: she talks to Abdellah Taïa in issue 31, Akwaeke Emezi in issue 32 and Leïla Slimani in issue 35. Max Lamb wrote for the magazine himself in issue 9, visiting the Harrisons in Cornwall.
